limitations: Current-survivor proxy universe; not a point-in-time ETF universe.
Yahoo auto-adjusted prices are a total-return proxy, not issuer NAV authority.
Macro and event snapshots are prospective context only; holdings, futures-curve, FX and tax inputs are absent.

methodology.curve: month-end historical observations in the same 10-point opportunity-score band
methodology.downside_risk: positioning-unwind watch requires prior 58-session gain >=15%, 5-session loss >=6%, relative loss versus SPY >=4%, and 21-session drawdown >=9%; only a material negative event upgrades it to downside bias
methodology.final_score: price score plus bounded fresh catalysts, decaying persistent sentiment, historical analogs, risk, and state-transition inputs; repeated coverage cannot multiply one theme
methodology.opportunity: 75% cross-sectional 21/63/126-session total-return momentum rank + 25% positive-trend confirmation
methodology.risk: equal-weight cross-sectional 63-session volatility and 126-session drawdown ranks

DEFENSE_ORDERS.rationale: Concrete defense-industrial state changes: Canadian-Ukrainian co-production, Japan cutting defense orders up to 80%, Detroit automakers in Pentagon drone talks, and Russia's anti-drone defense market surge.

ECONOMIC_GROWTH.rationale: Officially revised US Q3 GDP surge to 4.3%, heavily corroborated across sources and globally relevant for rate and growth expectations.

ENERGY_SUPPLY.rationale: Brent jumping on a Saudi refinery attack is the key verified price-moving event; European gas surge, the Lukoil international-assets deal and ConocoPhillips' Norway exit are material supply-structure changes.

FINANCIAL_STRESS.rationale: S&P downgrade watch on Nvidia over governance/AI-financing risk is a verified authoritative state change with corroboration; CVS Lane redemption freeze and loan write-down is a distinct confirmed credit stress event.

HEALTH_POLICY.rationale: Medicare's 2028 negotiated drug prices, loss of Medicare coverage for 300,000 legal immigrants, a first-in-class FDA approval and Virginia's Medicaid work-requirement delay are distinct verified policy changes.

MILITARY_GEOPOLITICS.rationale: Ukraine's strike on a Russian base with refinery attacks is a verified kinetic event with energy-market transmission; EU defence-readiness speech, a US-Venezuela military pact and a Hamas-Fatah declaration are distinct authoritative developments.

MONETARY_INFLATION.rationale: US inflation hitting a multi-month high with strong growth (Guardian, corroborated) plus a BoK rate hike corroborated by a chip-boom report; Fed discount-rate minutes add authoritative policy signal.

POLITICAL_SOCIAL_SHOCK.rationale: Two significant earthquakes (Peru M6.7, Mauritius-Reunion M6.4) from authoritative USGS plus a Northeast US state of emergency over storms with Florida disaster declarations are verified natural-shock events.

PRECIOUS_METALS.rationale: Gold falling to a one-year low on hot US inflation and rate-hike expectations is a verified, broadly corroborated price regime shift; RBI's gold repatriation adds central-bank demand context.

TECHNOLOGY_AI.rationale: Neuralink FDA pivotal-trial approval is a verified regulatory milestone; reports of advanced Nvidia chips reaching China despite the ban and B300 order delays are material supply-chain signals; Putin's data-center directive is state action.

TRADE_CONTROLS.rationale: Authoritative BBC report of a new sweeping US tariff round on EU, China and other partners, corroborated by multiple outlets; material global trade transmission and fresh market reaction.
